title: Safe handling of complementary medicine
summary: The implementation of the present project, the establishment of consultation hours for the safe use of complementary medicine in children with cancer in five pediatric oncology centres in the Rhine-Ruhr area, aims to improve the care situation for affected children and their families. The provision of science-based information on these therapies, intensive training of the medical staff involved and a scientific evaluation of the project are to achieve an improvement in the care situation. The well-founded scientific evaluation of the model project also serves to include counselling in the regular operation of four large university clinics and to be able to make recommendations for the establishment of similar counselling networks in other parts of Germany.

interventions.name: Parents of children with cancer who make use of a counselling session and medical staff of paediatric oncology who make use of a training session

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age of cancer patients: <18 years old
- Age of parents: 18 years and older
- Admission diagnosis: oncological disease in childhood
- Start of a conventional cancer therapy (e.g. chemotherapy) in one of the participating centres, not more than 4 weeks ago
- Written informed consent of parents (and children aged 16 years and older) to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
- Insufficient knowledge of German to understand the written consent form and the questionnaire
